subject.statement: Sam Bankman-Fried is still serving his 25-year sentence.

summary: Sam Bankman-Fried was sentenced in March 2024 to 25 years in federal prison. As of mid‑2026 there have been no credible reports of early release, pardon, or sentence reduction, so he remains incarcerated.
